[line]

[size=5][b]📜 WHAT IS MODXTER?[/b][/size]
ModXter is a lightweight utility mod designed specifically for Stardew Valley on Android. It allows you to easily back up and export all your currently installed mods to your device's public Downloads folder with a single tap or command!
Whether you are testing new custom assets, debugging, or just want a safe backup of your mobile modding setup, ModXter makes the process seamless.
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ KEY FEATURES[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]One-Click Export:[/b] Copies all contents of your [i]Mods[/i] folder directly to [b]/storage/emulated/0/Download/ModXter/[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Interactive UI Button:[/b] Includes a handy on-screen button for quick access. You can easily toggle its visibility on/off and adjust its X/Y coordinates to fit your screen layout perfectly.[/*]
[*][b]Live Progress Tracking:[/b] The copying process runs asynchronously in the background. It sends native in-game HUD messages every 5% of progress, letting you know it's working without freezing your game![/*]
[*][b]GMCM Integrated:[/b] Full support for [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i]. You can tweak the button's position, visibility, and settings seamlessly without leaving the game.[/*]
[*][b]Multilingual (i18n):[/b] Includes built-in translation support with English and Spanish available right out of the box.[/*]
[*][b]Console Command Support:[/b] Prefer the classic way? Just open the SMAPI console keyboard and type [b]copy[/b].[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ HOW TO USE[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game and load your save.[/*]
[*]Tap the [b]ModXter on-screen button[/b] (or open the SMAPI console and type [b]copy[/b]).[/*]
[*]Keep playing! You will see HUD messages updating you on the copying progress (5%, 10%, 15%...).[/*]
[*]Once it reaches a 100% success message, check your device's [b]Download/ModXter[/b] folder to find all your mods safely copied.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📥 INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI Android.[/*]
[*][i](Optional but highly recommended)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to easily manage the UI button settings.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and install it using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
